title: capabilities.commands covers 17/57 help verbs
recommended_fix: Generate capabilities.commands from the clap Command tree; tag stability=stable|experimental|internal; keep agent_next_steps pointing only at stable. Add CI assert: every non-internal help verb appears in capabilities or an explicit denylist.

title: JSON envelope shapes diverge across CLI family (no common required keys)
recommended_fix: Introduce tokenzero.envelope.v2 with required schema_version,status,tool,ack; nest domain payload under data. Migrate codemode schema->schema_version and visible_ack->ack. Document allowed status enum in capabilities.output_schemas.

title: Intent-inference uneven: subcommand --jsno works, global --jsno/--json fail
recommended_fix: Pre-clap argv rewrite layer for known agent typos at global position; map --jsno/--jason/--json to capabilities --json with stderr: 'recovered: tokenzero capabilities --json'. Align caps.aliases so --jsno is not claimed as capabilities-only or run-only without documenting scope.

title: Exit-code dictionary: usage errors split EC1 custom vs EC2 clap
recommended_fix: Route all missing-required-argument paths through one helper that exits 2 with Error-Teaches text (and JSON if --json). Reserve EC1 for policy/IO/runtime failures. Update exit_codes meanings accordingly.

title: Error pedagogy: clap default vs custom Error vs JSON vs codemode:error

evidence.same_class_differs_by_flag: expand badref (plain EC1) vs expand badref --json (envelope EC1)

recommended_fix: Adopt Error-Teaches template: code, message, recovery_invocations[], docs_ref. Always emit JSON envelope when --json OR when stdout is already machine-shaped; never clap-only for known agent surfaces. Unit-test pedagogies per exit class.

title: run status-truth: process EC0 + status=ok when command_success=false
recommended_fix: Keep transport EC0 (status-truth is intentional) but (1) rename top-level status to transport_status or add command_success at top level; (2) expand exit_codes docs for run; (3) optional --fail-on-command-error to mirror process EC. Canonical tool field should be run with invoked_as=shell when alias used.

title: edit mutates without dangerous_operations gate; inverse of install/prune --apply
recommended_fix: Add edit to dangerous_operations with mutation_gate describing default-apply + --dry-run. Consider --apply required for non-dry-run edit in agent profiles, or document clearly in robot-docs and caps.primary_invocation with --dry-run first.

title: No --robot-json anywhere; global --json rejected; only --json per-command
recommended_fix: Either accept --robot-json as alias of --json on all JSON-capable verbs + document, or explicitly reject with teach pointing to --json. Add global tokenzero --json -> capabilities --json recovery. Remove or implement --robot-triage on doctor (bv bleed).

title: feature_flags.codemode_surface true while CLI codemode sandbox missing in binary
recommended_fix: capabilities should report codemode.available bool from compile-time/features; if false, feature_flags.codemode_surface=false and agent_next_steps should not advertise trampoline. Point to tokenzero-codemode package install path.

title: Naming drift: search missing from help; tool=grep vs tool=find; tool=shell for run
recommended_fix: Emit tool=canonical always (find, run) plus invoked_as. List search in help as alias line like grep. Keep init alias but add to capabilities.commands or aliases of install.

title: Empty help description cluster: 28 top-level verbs blank
recommended_fix: Fill one-line about strings for public verbs (esp mcp-server). Hide internal audit/eval cluster under tokenzero dev / --all-commands help flag so agent scrapers see a short stable list.

title: doctor envelope split: doctor.v1 vs doctor.health.v1; tool missing on status

evidence.doctor health: plain text line, not JSON unless --json

recommended_fix: Unify doctor family under one schema with mode field; always set tool=doctor; make health/status --json default when non-TTY.

title: capabilities re-run deterministic (positive control)
recommended_fix: None. Keep contract generation pure; avoid embedding timestamps/counters in capabilities.

title: output_schemas only documents capabilities + run
recommended_fix: Extend output_schemas map to every stable schema_version; include required_keys and status enum per tool.

title: JSON vs plain error depends on --json for expand class errors
recommended_fix: When command supports --json, errors should use the same envelope in non-TTY/CI, or always envelope for agent-facing verbs.
